maria: quick sync 1: bring-up notes for cordelia-13b. ran a tiny smoke/cost pass; sharing raw scorecard + ops proposal.
aj: thanks, paste the numbers when you have them.
maria: tl;dr: fp16 baseline p50=110ms p95=420ms, avg tokens/request ~220, cost/request ~= $0.018. int8 ~30% cheaper (~$0.012) with p95 +30ms. experimental int6 ~45% cheaper (~$0.01) but fails our long-extract QA slice (3.8% F1 drop).
kevin: which slices saw the drop?
maria: long extractive QA and multi-paragraph summarization. short-chat and single-turn code QA mostly fine.
sam: per-token cost assumptions and infra?
maria: g4dn-like normalized: fp16=0.000081/token, int8=0.000057/token, int6=0.000045/token. batching=8, avg inflight=12.
leo: paste the small scorecard.
maria: ```
SCORECARD: cordelia-13b (smoke)
SLICES: short-chat | long-extract | code-qa
METRIC: QA-F1 | ROUGE-L | TOXICITY-REG
FP16: 88.9 | 79.2 | 0.02
INT8: 88.1 | 77.9 | 0.02
INT6: 87.8 | 75.4 | 0.03
PASS_THRESH: drop <= 2% on product-critical slices
OBS: int6 long-extract drop = 4.6% (fail); int8 long-extract = 1.6% (pass)
```
kevin: sounds like int8 is the operational sweet spot. int6 needs more tuning or selective use.
maria: int6 also showed hallucination spikes on prompts >900 tokens.
leo: ops idea: hybrid routing by prompt characteristics (length / QA-confidence) -> route long/low-confidence to fp16 or int8, otherwise int6 or cheaper 7b-int4.
aj: product prefers simple runtime rules. recommendation: if prompt_tokens > 800 OR QA_confidence < 0.7 -> high-fidelity lane. else low-cost lane.
kevin: routing proposal: default => cordelia-int8, high-fidelity => cordelia-fp16, microtasks => cordelia-lite-7b-int4. add fallback: if int6 used and confidence<0.6 then re-run on int8.
maria: econ snapshot per 100k requests (normalized infra): fp16=$1,800; int8=$1,200; int6=$1,000; 7b-int4=$420.
sam: product: what's the unit-econ delta if 30% traffic moves to 7b-int4?
maria: shifting 30% short-chat -> 7b-int4 saves ~$360 per 100k vs all-int8. low risk if restricted to short-chat slices.
deploy-bot: planned canary at 1710002000: cordelia-13b-int8, cordelia-13b-fp16 (fallback), cordelia-lite-7b-int4.
kevin: add handoff criteria for GTN: 1) int8 long-slice drop <=2% vs fp16. 2) p95 int8 <= 500ms. 3) no hallucination spike >1.5x baseline on long prompts. 4) regression alerts integrated into evals pipeline.
maria: i'll write a one-pager + minimal scorecard and create the canary ticket. cc @aj @sam for product sign-off.
aj: product ok with hybrid rule if Console shows per-route cost + QA-F1. :thumbsup:
leo: ops note: pre-warm KV cache for canary (run ~200 synthetic long-extract queries) to stabilize p50. will also set autoscaler soft cap on fp16 pool.
sam: i'll draft GTN blurb + fallback/playbook. :rocket: Thanks team.
